verdict.rationale: Reducto documents an async parse endpoint (`client.parse.run_job()` / POST /parse_async) that returns a job ID immediately, so the pipeline doesn't block. It also documents production completion webhooks via Svix, with cryptographic signing, retries with exponential backoff and a delivery dashboard; a batch queue for Parse/Extract jobs is mentioned too. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented job-status polling endpoint (only the returned job ID is shown) and independent or hands-on corroboration of the async and webhook flow.
